name: Flash Fire in the Valley

npcs.name: Tito Ramon
dialogue: The volcano and landslide alerts are still active. An electrical fault has now started a facility fire.
I repair this equipment, but it is not safe to save it. Use the clear exit, stay low, and leave it behind.
after_dialogue: The staff are outside. Nobody should return to the facility while it is burning.

choice.prompt: Smoke blocks the main corridor. How should personnel leave?

options.text: Use the clear alternate exit and stay low
options.result: Personnel use the clear alternate exit.
options.consequence: You guided personnel along the clear exit.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.text: Enter the smoke to find another way
options.result: Smoke can quickly make a corridor deadly.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Rhea
dialogue: I am a ranger, not a responder, but I know the service path around the smoke and unstable slopes.
Please bring the spare respirator. I can guide the group once my breathing is protected.
after_dialogue: I can breathe clearly now. Follow me along the service path, away from the smoke.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need the spare respirator. Please bring it, then help me get to the safe route, away from smoke and ash.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the safe route, away from smoke and ash now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the spare respirator, then speak with Rhea again.

items.name: Recover Dr. Voss’s final research log

quests.title: Find a battery radio for official fire evacuation updates.
Recover Dr. Voss’s final research log

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.rescue_kit: Search the clear route for a spare respirator before attempting the rescue.
quests.rescue_neighbor: Find Rhea and speak with her after collecting the spare respirator.
quests.community: Find Tito Ramon and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach Fire Safe Zone and stay clear of danger.

lessons: Use the planned safe exit and go to the family or community meeting place.
Stay with your group and tell responders if someone is missing.
Do not return to a fire-affected building until authorities say it is safe.

quiz.question: Smoke blocks your usual exit during a fire. What should you do?
options: Use a planned alternate safe exit and meet at the designated point
Hide in a room and wait without telling anyone
Go back inside after reaching safety to collect supplies
quiz.explanation: Know alternate escape routes and a meeting place. Do not re-enter until authorities say it is safe.

briefing: Damaged electrical systems ignite the facility. Raise the alarm, guide personnel toward safe exits, avoid smoke-filled corridors, and use an alternate route when the main passage is blocked. Recover Dr. Voss’s final research log from a safe area.
story_clue: The log says the World Engine became unstable after its power was increased beyond safe limits.
